title: NID DAT 2027: B.Des and Integrated M.Des (after Class 12)

light.label: Light
light.summary: The weekly operating system as written, for students in school, college or a job (about 12 to 15 hours a week).

intensive.label: Intensive
intensive.summary: The operating system plus two weak-axis blocks, weekly field missions, extra awareness cards and pitches (about 18 to 22 hours a week).

tasks.title: Choose your programme before you apply
tasks.detail: B.Des and the 5.5-year Integrated M.Des (after Class 12) are examined at the same time as the 2.5-year M.Des, so you can apply for only one. Programme, name, date of birth, mobile number and email cannot be changed later, even in the edit window.

tasks.title: Check your eligibility in the 2027-28 handbook
tasks.detail: Read section 5 for the age limits and qualifying-exam rules for your category. Use only the handbook downloaded from admissions.nid.edu.

tasks.title: Diagnostic: score yourself on six axes
tasks.detail: Twenty minutes, honestly. 1 means you have never done this; 5 means you do it reliably under time pressure. Your total sets your band and tunes the plan.

tasks.title: Start your design diary
tasks.detail: One page, four quadrants: what I saw, how it works, where it fails, what I'd change. Ten minutes.

tasks.title: Keep your kit small
tasks.detail: A cheap A4 sketchbook, a 2B pencil, a 0.5 black fineliner, one grey marker and one red pen for annotation.

tasks.title: Set up your critique loop
tasks.detail: Find two other aspirants and fix a weekly exchange day, or join Designforge open critique. Work reviewed within 48 hours teaches.

tasks.title: Prepare your application uploads
tasks.detail: A colour photograph taken at a professional studio and a scanned signature, each a JPG of 50 to 200 KB. Category, PwD or other certificates, where they apply, as PDFs up to 1 MB.

tasks.title: First Sunday review: plan week 1
tasks.detail: Read the four non-negotiables, fix a daily time for your drill, and write down your two lowest diagnostic axes.

tasks.title: Know where the programmes are
tasks.detail: NID Ahmedabad's 5.5-year Integrated M.Des has 15 disciplines across five streams. NID Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana and Assam publish their B.Des and integrated programmes on their own websites.
